dynamic_line.gendered_line: Ooooh, boy.  I was ready for this.  The winds were blowing this way for years.  I had a full last man on earth shelter set up just out of town.  So, of course, just my luck: I was miles out of town for a work conference when China attacked and the world ended.

responses.text: You said you could tell me more about the shelter if I wanted.  How did these things get built?
What do you think happened?  You must have some interesting theories on why everything went to shit.
responses.//: If the player already confronted the Prepper about their shelter and is gated out of that part of the conversation, this allows the player to still have a fun chat about apocalypse theories with them.

responses.text: Hey, uh…  I noticed you left a computer down in your shelter.  I didn't intend to pry, but you said I could go through everything.  So, I read a little of what you wrote.  You wanna talk about it?
